newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine consumer prices fell 0.5 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Argentine consumer prices fell 0.5 pct in March.

text.p: Argentina's consumer price index for March fell 0.5 percent on the previous month, versus a 0.5 percent fall in March 1996 and this February's 0.4 percent increase, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.

March's deflation figure takes year-on-year consumer inflation to 1.0 percent, versus 0.2 percent annualized inflation the same month last year and 0.9 percent annualized inflation in February this year.
